info.name: CSP Modder
info.summary: Patch the Content-Security-Policy of URL-matched pages
info.description:
Nextcloud computes a single Content-Security-Policy for the whole instance, and apps can only widen it for every page at once. Embedding a third party service usually needs the policy relaxed on a handful of pages and left alone everywhere else.
CSP Modder adds an admin page where each entry is a rule: a regular expression selecting URLs, and a list of directives and values to allow on them. Values are only ever added, and only to the directives Nextcloud's policy API models, so a rule cannot tighten the policy or reach a directive the server builds itself.
This is an administrator tool. A careless rule can break the pages it matches, so each rule carries a comment field to record why it exists.
